response.sql: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS base FROM site_avg), status_avg AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS st_avg FROM site_avg WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept AS (SELECT a.avg_faces, a.avg_faces - b.base AS over_base, a.avg_faces - st.st_avg AS over_status FROM site_avg a CROSS JOIN baseline b JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = a.entrystat WHERE a.avg_faces > st.st_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_kept_site_avg, AVG(over_base) AS avg_excess_over_baseline, AVG(over_status) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Only sites that have at least one scanmesh record with a non-null facetfaces value are included in the per-site averages. This covers the baseline and the status averages. Sites with no mesh records, or only null face counts, have no average and are skipped.
A missing access status means entrystat IS NULL. Such sites count toward the overall baseline but are never kept.
If no site is kept, the query returns a single row of NULLs.
